name: Rrp Semiconductor Limited
summary: Rrp Semiconductor Limited trades in electronic parts in India. The company is involved in the information and technology business, such as semiconductor and digital chips, and others. It serves electronics and semiconductor companies, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), technology and electronics companies, industrial enterprises, and other businesses requiring semiconductor and related electronic components and solutions. The company was formerly known as G D Trading and Agencies Limited and changed its name to Rrp Semiconductor Limited in June 2024. Rrp Semiconductor Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Thane, India.
